clue.text: Clause pedant re-edited and summarised

indicators.note: something re-edited has been reworked, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fussy pedant revises a contract clause and boils it down.
explanation.definitionFit: To encapsulate a matter is to express its essentials briefly, so encapsulated means summed up in short.

clue.text: European queen turning round in great circle

indicators.note: turning signals that the word for round is read backwards

parts.note: a rota is a round of duties taken in turn

explanation.surface: A European monarch turns about while circling the globe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' looks like a preposition but is a noun, a round of duties; 'turning' reads it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The equator is the great circle of the Earth lying midway between the poles.

clue.text: Stylish character in Greek clubs

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: A fashionable figure frequents Greek nightclubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic is a borrowing from French meaning elegantly fashionable.

clue.text: Average cut for Root

parts.note: par is the normal or average level
a snip is a small cut

explanation.surface: An ordinary trim for Joe Root, the England cricketer.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital R makes Root look like Joe Root, an England cricket captain; it is a root vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: A parsnip is a pale, tapering root vegetable, so it is an example of a root.

clue.text: Perfect note on instrument, old before its time

parts.note: ut is the old name for the note now called do, the first of the scale

indicators.note: the old letter is shifted early in the instrument's word, arriving before it should

parts.note: a piano is a musical instrument

explanation.surface: A flawless note played on an instrument that has aged prematurely.
explanation.walkthrough: Ut is the old name for do. 'before its time' means the instrument's own O for old arrives early, jumping to the front; 'on' puts the note first.
explanation.definitionFit: Utopian describes an ideal, flawless state, after More's imagined perfect island Utopia.

clue.text: Bet poet's no Democrat

indicators.note: no here means without, so the party's letter is removed from the poet

parts.note: Dante is the Italian poet; the 's reads as 'is'

explanation.surface: A wager that a certain poet is no supporter of the Democrats.
explanation.definitionFit: An ante is a stake put up in poker before the cards are dealt, a kind of bet.

clue.text: Glamorous objects quickly put in fell over

indicators.note: over signals that the whole assembly is turned upside down in this down entry
put in signals one word placed inside the other

parts.note: to fell a tree is to axe it
cito is Latin for quickly, seen on prescriptions

explanation.surface: Fancy objects were hurriedly placed inside something that toppled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put in' makes ACITOXE, and 'over' turns it round. Cito, Latin for quickly, is still written on urgent prescriptions.
explanation.definitionFit: Exotica are striking, unusual objects from distant places, collected for their glamour.

clue.text: Follow taxi belonging to Egypt's gutless opposition leaders

parts.note: to shadow someone is to follow them
a cab is a taxi
in can mean belonging to, as in a member in a club

indicators.note: gutless means the insides are removed, leaving only the outer letters of the country

explanation.surface: Tailing a taxi carrying cowardly Egyptian opposition figures.
explanation.walkthrough: In British politics the Shadow Cabinet is the senior team of the main opposition party, each shadowing a minister.
explanation.definitionFit: The Shadow Cabinet comprises the senior spokespeople of the parliamentary opposition.

clue.text: Unfortunately, scoundrels use naivety

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things going wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Sadly, rogues prey on the trusting.
explanation.definitionFit: Credulousness is a readiness to believe things too easily, which is innocence or naivety.

clue.text: Uniform adopted by boxer in that woman's transport company

indicators.note: in signals the boxer piece set inside the word for that woman's

parts.note: her is the possessive for that woman

indicators.note: adopted by signals the letter taken inside the boxer's name

parts.note: Muhammad Ali was a famous boxer
Uniform is U in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A boxer wears a uniform in a woman's haulage firm.
explanation.definitionFit: A haulier is a business that carries goods by road, a freight transport firm.

clue.text: Sporty exit?

definitions.meaning: ... describes someone fond of open-air activities
split as ..., a door out, which is an exit

explanation.surface: An athletic way out.
explanation.definitionFit: An outdoor type loves open-air pursuits, and a door leading out serves as a way to leave.

clue.text: Tax of the French emptied treasury

parts.note: du is French for of the

indicators.note: emptied means the inside letters are removed, leaving only the outer two

explanation.surface: A French levy has drained the exchequer.
explanation.definitionFit: A duty is a tax charged on goods, such as on imports or alcohol.

clue.text: Mean villager conceals bone

indicators.note: conceals signals the answer is held within these written words

explanation.surface: A stingy countryman hides a bone, like a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: The anvil, or incus, is one of the tiny ossicle bones of the middle ear.

clue.text: Half of evergreen bark

indicators.note: half of selects the second four of the tree's eight letters

parts.note: the tamarind is an evergreen tropical tree

explanation.surface: Bark that is half of an evergreen tree's covering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half of' takes the back half of TAMARIND.
explanation.definitionFit: Rind is the tough outer layer of a tree, its bark, as well as of fruit or cheese.

clue.text: Restraint could be prelude to mating

definitions.meaning: in chess, ... often comes before checkmate

explanation.surface: Holding back might come before romance.
explanation.definitionFit: A check limits or curbs something, and in chess a check threatening the king can lead to mate.

clue.text: Puts out one book from painter

indicators.note: from here means taken away from, so the letter leaves the painter's name

parts.note: George Stubbs was an English painter famous for horses
B is the abbreviation for book; only one of the painter's two is taken

explanation.surface: An artist loses a volume and puts it outside.
explanation.definitionFit: To stub a cigarette is to extinguish it by pressing it, so stubs means puts out.

clue.text: Conflict is in fashion in this vessel?

parts.note: war is armed conflict
the contraction 's stands for is
hip means trendy, in fashion

explanation.surface: Wondering whether conflict is the trend aboard this ship.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as war's hip: conflict is fashionable, which fits a fighting ship, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A warship is a naval vessel built and armed for combat.

clue.text: Final dance in game

parts.note: net means final, after all deductions, as in net profit
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: The last dance takes place mid-match.
explanation.definitionFit: Netball is a team ball sport where goals are scored through a high ring.

clue.text: Say a craft is calmer regularly

definitions.note: say marks an example: the word a is one instance of the definite or indefinite kind

parts.note: art is skill or craft

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of these two words

explanation.surface: Suppose a boat is becalmed in steadier waters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Say a' is the definition: the little word a is an example of an article in grammar.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar a and the are articles, so a is an example of one.

clue.text: Trojan Women perhaps grew old in Troy, lacking nothing

indicators.note: in places the ageing word inside the shortened city
lacking means going without, so the zero letter is dropped

parts.note: taken as written
O, shaped like zero, means nothing
aged means grew old

explanation.surface: The women of Troy aged in their city with nothing left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking nothing' removes O from TROY to make TRY, which holds AGED.
explanation.definitionFit: The Trojan Women is a tragedy by Euripides, so it is an example of one.

clue.text: Rule out involving Romeo in piece

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the letter is placed within the excluding word

parts.note: to except something is to exclude or rule it out
Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Banning any extract that features Shakespeare's Romeo.
explanation.definitionFit: An excerpt is a passage or extract taken from a longer work.

clue.text: Panel with gold picture

parts.note: a table can be a flat board or panel, as in a table of figures
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A painting on a wooden panel with gold leaf.
explanation.definitionFit: A tableau is a striking scene or picture, often of figures posed still.

clue.text: After end of riot, Trump left, denying newspaper confection

indicators.note: after places the trumping word following the riot's last letter
end of picks the final letter of the word riot

parts.note: to ruff is to play a trump in card games

indicators.note: denying means refusing, so the newspaper's letters are removed

parts.note: taken as written
the FT is the Financial Times newspaper

explanation.surface: After a riot, a president walks off, snubbing the press, with a sweet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'denying newspaper' strips FT from LEFT, leaving LE.
explanation.definitionFit: A truffle is a soft chocolate sweet, a kind of confection.

clue.text: Thrift in company trapped by money supply

indicators.note: trapped by signals the firm's letters held inside the other piece
supply read as supplely, bending into a new shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Frugality within a firm hemmed in by the money supply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supply' looks like a noun in money supply; read as supple-y, bending, it signals the anagram ENOMY, and 'trapped by' sets the firm inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Economy is careful management of resources, which is thrift.

clue.text: Religious figure's male friend from the east

indicators.note: in an across entry, coming from the east means read from right to left

parts.note: ami is French for friend

explanation.surface: A cleric's male companion arrives from the Orient.
explanation.definitionFit: An imam is a Muslim leader who leads prayers in a mosque.

clue.text: Abandon insignificant drudge

definitions.meaning: to ... a plan is to cancel or drop it
... as an adjective means small or of little account
a lowly person doing menial work

explanation.surface: Drop the trivial servant.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrub covers cancelling something, something stunted or worthless, and a lowly menial worker.

clue.text: Marry sweetheart before 1 November

indicators.note: before places the sweetheart ahead of the following letters

parts.note: jo is an old Scots word for a sweetheart
the numeral 1 resembles the letter I
November is N in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Wed your beloved ahead of the first of November.
explanation.walkthrough: '1 November' looks like a date; it is I then N.
explanation.definitionFit: To join two people is to unite them in marriage.

clue.text: Fired-up expression of contempt causes shock

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: nuts! is a dismissive exclamation, as in nuts to you

explanation.surface: An angry sneer comes as a jolt.
explanation.definitionFit: To stun someone is to shock or astonish them.

clue.text: Outcast discovered song

indicators.note: dis-covered: with its cover taken off, so the outer letters go

parts.note: a pariah is an outcast

explanation.surface: An exile was found singing.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a solo song in an opera.

clue.text: One selecting e-reader?

parts.note: a lector is a reader, especially one reading lessons in church

explanation.surface: Someone choosing an e-book device.
explanation.walkthrough: e-reader splits into E and a word for reader.
explanation.definitionFit: An elector is a voter, who chooses or selects candidates.

clue.text: Agitation about mistake, losing both ends of iron

indicators.note: each of the two words loses an end letter: the mistake its last, the agitation its last
about signals one word wrapped round the other

parts.note: fuss is agitation or commotion
an error is a mistake

explanation.surface: Fretting over an error, someone drops the ends of an iron bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts ERROR in FUSS; 'losing both ends' cuts the end of each, ERRO in FUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Ferrous is the adjective for things containing or relating to iron.

clue.text: Suggestive treatment they occasionally start to prepare, fabricating honey trap

indicators.note: occasionally picks every other letter of the word they
start to picks the opening letter of prepare
fabricating means making up, so the letters are built into a new order

explanation.surface: Spies occasionally prepare a seduction sting as a kind of therapy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'occasionally' gives HY, 'start to' gives P; 'fabricating' turns HONEY TRAP into NOTHERAPY.
explanation.definitionFit: Hypnotherapy treats patients by hypnosis, which works through suggestion.
